scope.summary: Implement StudioCommandBatch: an ordered command sequence that executes as ONE transactional unit producing one aggregate StudioEditProposal, one promotion decision, and one coalesced StudioHistoryEntry group, so a recorded macro / batch job / plugin multi-step edit is a single reviewable, single-undoable operation rather than N unrelated authority writes. Partial failure rolls the batch back.
acceptance_criteria: StudioCommandBatch is one transactional proposal/promotion/history group; atomic rollback proven
proof_targets: single-proposal + coalesced-history batch test; rollback negative
expected_tests: live: batch commits as one proposal + one coalesced history group
negative: mid-batch failure rolls whole batch back (no partial authority write)

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: Multi-step automation writes N unrelated authority rows; not single-undoable/reviewable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
